progressBarType; UPS's generic token, seen live on a delayed Ground Saver parcel whose packageStatus read Update. The adapter reads a token only when the newest scan's code is unmapped.
actCode: "Shipper created a label, UPS has not received the package yet." Some replies send it with no clock.
actCode: "Drop-Off", the sender handed the parcel in at an access point.

actCode: "The UPS Access Point™ location has prepared the package for return to UPS or pickup by UPS." Seen right after a drop-off; UPS uses the same sentence when an uncollected parcel goes back, where the later scans decide the stage.
actCode: "Pickup Scan". After the parcel's delivery leg, as when UPS collects it from the access point it waited at, the adapter reads it as transit.
actCode: UPS collecting the parcel from the access point it was dropped off at, between the drop-off and the origin scan.
actCode: the origin scan, worded "Arrived at Facility" like AR. UPS files it under its "We Have Your Package" milestone.
actCode: "Arrived at Facility".
actCode: "Departed from Facility".
actCode: "Processing at UPS Facility".
actCode: "Processing at UPS Facility".
actCode: "Your package was processed at our facility."
actCode: "Your package is on the way", without a location.
actCode: "Package is in transit to a UPS facility", seen before the origin scan: UPS has the parcel, not yet at a facility.
actCode: "Export Scan".
actCode: "Import Scan".
actCode: a late flight delayed the parcel, which still arrives that day.
actCode: "We're sorry this package may experience a temporary delay."
actCode: "We’re sorry your package was delayed. We are adjusting delivery plans as quickly as possible."
actCode: "UPS will be in your area and will deliver your package a day early."
actCode: "Saturday Delivery has been requested. / Delivery will be rescheduled for Saturday." A new delivery plan; the parcel continues.
actCode: "Due to weather, your package is delayed by one business day." Seen between facility scans; the parcel continues.
actCode: "Your package will be delivered one business day later than expected." Seen right after a facility scan; the parcel continues.
actCode: UPS corrected the postal code and the parcel continues.
actCode: "The package has been redirected and forwarded to the delivery center."
actCode: a delivery change request, processed once the parcel is back at the facility.
actCode: the receiver asked for a temporary change of delivery address.
actCode: "Delivery to a UPS Access Point™ location is pending."
actCode: "We will deliver the package to the original receiver's address as the receiver requested." Seen after UPS collected the parcel from the access point it waited at.
actCode: a UPS My Choice® delivery change was modified or cancelled.

actCode: "The package will be delivered to the UPS Access Point™ location requested by the receiver." A future instruction: the shared classifier read it as ready for pickup, but the parcel then went out for delivery.

entries.wording: Delivery instructions have been provided by the receiver.
entries.note: actCode: the receiver's delivery instructions, seen three weeks after the label while UPS had only the label. A notice and no scan, left without a stage on purpose: the newest other scan decides, so the parcel does not read in transit before UPS has it.
actCode: "Package moving to local post office", Ground Saver's hand-off to the post office.
actCode: "Package transferred to post office", a Ground Saver parcel handed to USPS for the last leg. The reply then names its USPS number.
actCode: "Received by the local post office", after LX.
actCode: "Package has been received from UPS Access Point™ location. UPS will process as necessary."
actCode: the access point is closing; UPS collects its parcels and the receiver is contacted. Not available for pickup: the same scan says delivery to an alternate access point is pending.
actCode: "Your package is prepared for clearance." The import brokerage step before release.
actCode: "Duties or taxes are due on this package." The receiver has to pay before delivery.
actCode: "Your package is being held until duties and taxes are paid. Awaiting customer action." Seen right after 7F.

entries.wording: The package is at the clearing agency awaiting final release.
entries.note: A scan UPS sends with an empty actCode, read by its whole wording. The clearing agency is UPS's customs broker; the duties notice 7F and the hold OQ can follow.
actCode: "Loaded on Delivery Vehicle" or "Out For Delivery". UPS groups the first under its On the Way milestone, but the delivery followed the same day each time.
actCode: "Out For Delivery Today".
actCode: the receiver was not available; a second attempt follows.
actCode: "The receiver was not available at the time of the final delivery attempt." Seen after two 48 scans. The attempt failed; a hold, an access point or a return comes as a later scan.
actCode: the business was closed; a second attempt follows.
actCode: UPS could not deliver and is taking the parcel to an access point.

actCode: "The company or receiver name is incorrect. This will delay delivery. We're attempting to update this information." Seen after Out For Delivery, before the receiver moved the delivery to an access point: the delivery waits on the receiver's details, as an incorrect address does.
actCode: "Delivered to UPS Access Point™".
actCode: "UPS Access Point™ possession", right after 2Q. The shared classifier left it in transit.

actCode: "Pick up your package soon as it is nearing the maximum hold limit and may be returned to the sender." A reminder to collect a held parcel, seen after an access point hold and a failed attempt; the shared classifier read the possible return as an exception.

actCode: "DELIVERED" after the receiver collected the parcel from an access point.
